name: @immediately-run/mdx-plugins
description: immediately.run's in-house remark plugins for the MDX safe subset (admonitions §12, wiki-links §13, heading/section-id anchors §15) + the slug grammar (textSlug/sectionId). The SINGLE source of truth shared byte-for-byte between the transpiler's compiled path and the SDK's non-executable safe renderer (TRUST_MODES §5.1 / R3-213), so the two render paths can't drift. A leaf package: pure mdast transforms, no babel/mdx/react runtime dep (only a type-only `unified` import).
